K1.sabe: There was a secret place where time barely passed.
K1.accion: Look in the sky for something that doesn't move like a star.
K1.pregunta: Was there somewhere time ran differently?

K2.titulo: What you see in the sky is displaced
K2.sabe: Near the Knot, light bends: what I see in the sky isn't where it seems.
K2.accion: Look at the image knowing that it lies.
K2.pregunta: Why could nobody find that place?

KC.titulo: How much what you see must be corrected
KC.sabe: The image of the place appears turned about eighteen degrees toward the Ember.
KC.accion: From the image, turn your eyes eighteen degrees away from the Ember.
KC.pregunta: How much must what you see be corrected?

K3.titulo: I know where the Laboratory really is
K3.sabe: The Laboratory is inside the Knot, eighteen degrees past its image, on the side away from the Ember.
K3.accion: Fly there with the graduated sight (G).

K4.titulo: What the Counterweight is and what it replaces
K4.sabe: The Counterweight is a replacement engine: it goes where the machine's engine was and pays the debt.
K4.accion: Find it and carry it to the machine.

K5.titulo: The Counterweight's clock must be synchronized
K5.sabe: Its clock must show the same as the machine's, and every journey throws it off.
K5.accion: At the cradle, match the two clocks with the two wheels.

K6.titulo: Where and when it is installed
K6.sabe: It is installed in the Engine Room on Scar, and it only fits during the nine o’clock pulse.
K6.accion: Arrive before nine, pull the old engine out with the lever and wait for the pulse.
K6.pregunta: Where and when is it installed?

K7.titulo: The mouths of a Gate have different clocks
K7.sabe: Each mouth of a Gate lives its own time: what you see on the other side is not the day you arrive.
K7.accion: Before crossing, count the drift of each mouth.
K7.pregunta: Why do things arrive from different times?

K8.sabe: The Institute’s great test is on day forty since I took off.
K8.pregunta: When will the great test be?
